name: defra-ai-plugins
description: Defra GitHub Copilot CLI plugins — agents and skills that encode Defra software development standards and GDS service standards.

plugins.name: defra-pii-redaction
plugins.description: Intercepts all LLM interactions — prompts, tool inputs, and tool outputs — and redacts UK PII before data reaches or leaves the model, using a configurable Python redaction script.

plugins.name: defra-shared
plugins.description: Cross-cutting Defra standards as installable skills and guardrail hooks: branching, commit messages, code-quality gates, security & PII handling, and accessibility. Referenced by every other Defra plugin so cross-cutting standards live in one place. No agent — skills + hooks only.

plugins.name: frontend-developer
plugins.description: Builds Defra-compliant frontends following the GOV.UK Design System, WCAG 2.2 AA, and Defra software development standards (Hapi + Nunjucks + SCSS + Vitest).

plugins.name: ticket-writer
plugins.description: Creates well-structured JIRA tickets (stories and tasks) for any team. Ships default templates for user-facing stories and technical tasks, with support for custom templates at runtime.

plugins.name: user-centred-designer
plugins.description: User-centred design skills for Defra: service blueprints and journey maps, document and presentation standards (GOV.UK content design, Defra visual standards), and interaction and content design for CDP frontends. No agent, skills only, built from the AI Capability and Enablement team's delivery work.
